text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly put together some documents
due
today, and am running to deliver
them, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A strong gust of wind blows them away!
My spirits
start to sink, when...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Whoopsie. These your papers?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Now, what shall I do with these?
choice_data_list: Yeah, thanks for picking it uâ
Yeah, thanks for picking it u—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who picked them up, so
it's up to
me to decide what to do with
them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, what'll it be? Ask nicely, and I'll give
them
back to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't shake the feeling that she's
teasing me
again...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Nice and obedient, aren't we?
However...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Your phrasing needs improvement. Try
this: "Give
them to me and I swear I'll do
anything you ask."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Can you really afford to be wasting time
here? It
says these documents are due
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She isn't wrong. I barely have any time
until the
submission deadline. Desperate
times call for
desperate measures...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, there's a good trainer! I knew
you had it
in you!
choice_data_list: I'll do anything, please just give it back...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Here you go. They're all yours.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You know, you're pretty good at
begging when
you put your mind to it.
Let's do this again, when
the fancy
strikes.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Suit yourself. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli leaves with my documents
in
hand—the documents due today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can still make it in time if I hurry and
reprint
them. With that in mind, I head
back to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I just manage to submit the documents
on time.
Just as I'm breathing out a sigh
of relief...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmm... So this is your training plan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli shows up for the second
time
today, still holding my documents
from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, your trainee shows
a fair
amount of promise. I guess that
explains your
confident attitude. But
still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shuffle!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I won't know if I never race her. Next
time we see
each other, let's make it on
the track. What do
you think, big shot?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli utters what sounds an
awful lot like
a challenge and walks
away.
